Plumbing, HVAC and Electrical Services in Northlake, TX

No two of these calls look alike, so here’s what each one usually involves.

1. Plumbing Services in Northlake

Water heaters are our most common call here. A tank that’s leaking at the base is done. One that lost a heating element or thermostat is worth fixing, and we’ll tell you which you’ve got before you spend anything. We install and repair both tank and tankless units, gas and electric.

Drains come next. Kitchen lines clog with grease, and the newer builds often have long horizontal runs that catch everything. We clear the line, then run a camera so you can see what caused it. For heavy buildup or roots, hydro jetting scours the pipe wall instead of just punching a hole through the clog.

We also handle leak detection, slab leaks, burst pipes, repiping, toilets and faucets, garbage disposals and sump pumps.

Gas Lines:

New gas lines for ranges, dryers, fireplaces, outdoor kitchens and generators, plus leak detection and repair. Every line gets pressure tested before the gas goes back on. If you smell gas, get outside and call from there.

Water Filtration & Softening:

Denton County water is hard. You see it as white crust on fixtures, spotty glassware and sediment in the water heater. We test your water first, then recommend a whole-home filter, a softener or an under-sink system only if it’ll actually help.

2. HVAC Services in Northlake

Summer is the real test here. Long run times, big open floor plans and two-story houses that never cool evenly upstairs. Most AC calls come down to a dead capacitor, a refrigerant leak, a clogged condensate line or a failing contactor. We check the simple stuff first, like the filter and thermostat, before quoting anything big.

Winter is shorter but it still catches people out. A furnace that hasn’t run since February often quits on the first cold night. We repair gas furnaces, electric heat and heat pumps, and check the heat exchanger and flue while we’re there, because a crack in the exchanger is a carbon monoxide risk.

We also install replacements when a repair stops making sense, and we clean air ducts and dryer vents. A lint-packed dryer vent is both a fire risk and the reason your dryer takes two cycles.

3. Electrical Services in Northlake

Breakers that keep tripping, outlets that feel warm, lights that dim when the AC starts. None of these are worth ignoring. We trace the cause instead of just resetting the breaker, because a trip usually means a loose connection, an overloaded circuit or a failing device somewhere on the line.

The upgrade side is busy here too. EV chargers, hot tubs, outdoor kitchens, shop circuits in the garage. All of these need a load calculation first. Sometimes the panel can take it. Sometimes you need a load management device, which costs a lot less than a full panel upgrade. Occasionally you do need the upgrade, and we’ll say so.

We also install standby generators and transfer switches, whole-home surge protection, recessed and landscape lighting, ceiling fans, and smoke and CO detectors.

Serving Northlake and Nearby Towns

Along with Northlake, our trucks cover Argyle, Roanoke, Justin, Trophy Club, Haslet, Flower Mound and the rest of the Denton County area. If you’re just over the line, we’re still close.

05 / Questions from Northlake

GOOD TO
KNOW.

Ask the team ↗
How do I know whether a gas line needs repair or full replacement?

A single corroded fitting or a damaged section can be repaired. If the line is old black iron with rust along its length, or the pressure test shows loss in more than one spot, replacement is the safer call. We pressure test first, so the answer is based on a reading, not a guess.

Do you work with tankless and standard water heaters?

Both, gas and electric. Tankless units need descaling once a year in this area because the water is hard. Tank units need a yearly flush for the same reason.

Is trenchless sewer repair available in Northlake?

Yes. When a camera shows a cracked or collapsed sewer line, trenchless lining or pipe bursting repairs it without digging up the whole yard. We’ll show you the camera footage and explain which method fits.

How can I improve my home's indoor air quality?

Start with the basics: a clean filter at the right MERV rating, and ducts that aren’t leaking into the attic. After that, duct cleaning helps if you’ve had a remodel or heavy dust, and a whole-home humidifier or dehumidifier helps with the dryness in winter and the mugginess in summer.

Do you provide commercial plumbing services in Northlake?

Yes. Restaurants, offices, retail and light industrial. We handle grease line clearing, water heaters, backflow testing and repairs, and we can work outside business hours when a shutdown isn’t practical.

How do I improve water heater efficiency when replacing my entire HVAC system?

If you’re replacing the HVAC anyway, it’s a good time to look at the water heater, especially if it’s eight years or older. Doing both at once means one set of permits and one round of disruption. We’ll check the age and condition and tell you honestly if it can wait.

Why does my dryer vent need professional cleaning?

Lint builds up along the duct and chokes the airflow. The dryer runs longer, the clothes stay damp and the lint itself is a fire risk. If your dryer needs two cycles or the outside flap barely moves, it’s overdue.

Are ductless mini-splits efficient for whole-home cooling?

They’re excellent for additions, garages, shops and rooms the main system never cools properly, which in two-story homes here is usually the upstairs. For a whole house, a multi-zone system works but costs more than one central unit. We’ll price both.

When should I schedule a service versus a humidifier?

Service your AC in spring and your heating in fall. A humidifier is a separate add-on, worth considering if winter dryness bothers you, and it’s usually installed during a heating service visit.

How often should my AC and furnace be serviced?

Once a year each. AC in the spring before it gets hot, heating in the fall before the first cold snap. Skipping it is how small problems become July emergencies.

Do you offer electrical services in Northlake?

Yes. Our licensed electricians handle panel upgrades, breaker and wiring repairs, EV charger installs, generators, lighting and whole-home surge protection across Northlake and the surrounding area.

Can you repair a water heater in Northlake the same day?

Usually. Our trucks carry the common parts, like elements, thermostats and thermocouples, so most water heater repairs are finished on the first visit. A full replacement is typically same-day or next-day depending on the unit.

Do you offer whole-house water filtration in Northlake?

Yes. We install whole-home filtration systems, water softeners and under-sink reverse osmosis. We test your water first so you only buy what the test says you need.
